critical.title: The new common metadata output rule makes the draft action impossible under the unchanged binder/gate; internal registration allocation also omits current draft/review refs
evidence: Every metadata output has parent P05/f08_driver18_root_producer_executor_codex and a 32hex leaf. producer.prepare_draft requires out within registration_namespace. gate.scope:178-180 requires that namespace beneath P05 and its own leaf contain the complete 32hex run_uuid. The only eligible ancestor of a direct executor/<UUID> output is that output itself; executor/P05 ancestors cannot contain a 32hex run_uuid. But binder.draft:71 calls gate.safe(out, namespace), which at authority:55-56 requires out != namespace and a strict descendant. These constraints have no common legal draft output.

With namespace == output, producer.prepare_draft:248 writes four captured canonical copies before binder rejects at :250. With a conventional separate registration namespace, producer :244 rejects immediately after the common metadata leaf/request were created. No actual copies or directories were created in this review.

run_registration:339 protects only [s]. Current dref/regref/index/mfref and the accumulated Reader refs from reviewed are missing. Scope cannot pre-pin the future current draft hash without a cycle. An independently supplied valid current draft/review can therefore select a fresh registration child inside its sealed draft/input tree; leaf writes occur before later runtime refusal. A fix that merely blocks this child without separating legal draft/native paths leaves the pipeline unusable.

The unchanged authority.registration:231-232 also requires every registration code/draft ref inside registration_namespace. stage-code currently allocates another fresh direct executor/<UUID> leaf, while draft must use a different fresh leaf. No UUID-named namespace can contain both sibling leaves under the common rule. Fix the related stage/draft namespace layout together, not only the draft predicate.
critical.impact: The proposed runnable producer cannot create a complete registration draft through its declared action interface. The allocation rule also fails to protect current externally supplied draft/review trees at internal registration allocation.

Retain executor/<freshUUID> only for unrelated metadata actions.

Preserve input parent protection, work/four-phase exclusions, grant preflight/auth dedicated fresh roots and forward-only CAS/origin guards.

important.title: Direct outer/prepare seal paths do not enforce the actual initial command predicate used by capture_action
evidence: The revised capture closure now requires real grant, original bundle/MF, exact raw/event refs, external nonauthor review and real session pairing. capture_action:410-412 additionally requires the original exec_command input to contain the exact literal PowerShell launcher argv/cwd dispatch.

seal_outer calls original_capture_closure directly but never capture_action. The common closure does not read/check the initial input cmd or cwd against action_identity; it compares the action header identity and reviewed event tuple only. Frozen outer_completion:405-407 checks a nonempty raw cmd equal to original.tool_command, which seal_outer sets from that same raw input; it does not check the cmd equals the expected literal launcher command.

The same missing raw command predicate is present in direct seal_prepare's shared closure path. A genuine externally reviewed request-response association for a different nonempty Root command can satisfy the listed pair predicates while its action header claims the launcher identity. The current pairing review contract attests host event association; it is not an executable exact-command assertion.
important.impact: The required command binding can be bypassed by entering the seal actions directly; original event authenticity and a claimed action identity alone do not mechanically enforce the dispatched launcher bytes.
minimum_fix: Move or duplicate the existing exact initial raw input cmd/workdir validation into original_capture_closure, before it returns and before seal_outer writes an invocation/completion.
Derive the expected quoted literal command from the current action_identity exactly as launch_request/capture_action already do; verify actual initial input bytes parse to that cmd and Root cwd.

Retain typed original initial/terminal response, strict terminal input/session, exact event/action/raw refs, independent review and original capture MF. Apply the common check to capture_action, seal_outer and seal_prepare.
Do not manufacture command identity, actions, reviews or responses; missing/contradictory real dispatch binding remains FATAL_OPEN. Keep all frozen consumer source unchanged.
